cleared.check: Task 3: where Arc's native value hook sits against the call frame checkpoint, read in arc-node v0.8.6 crates/evm/src/evm.rs
cleared.result: before_frame_init and check_blocklist_and_create_log (evm.rs 516-625) run in checked_frame_init before init_frame (evm.rs 807-837), so they run inside the parent frame and before the child frame takes its checkpoint and moves the value. The blocklist read is journal.sload of 0x1800000000000000000000000000000000000001 (evm.rs 438-452), a journaled read whose warm entry belongs to the parent frame. The hook writes nothing; under Zero7 its account probe is bracketed by checkpoint and checkpoint_revert (evm.rs 569-580). A rejected value call returns a reverted frame result before any balance moves. For a non-precompile call the EIP-7708 Transfer log is pushed after init_frame (evm.rs 871-891), after the child checkpoint recorded the log index, so a reverting child truncates it. The value move itself is revm's transfer inside the child checkpoint.

leadResults.answer: Celo (2,124 sequences on the block-validation table, plus the builder table) and X Layer (2,124 sequences over two journal families) ran from the shipped machine code with no mismatch against the revm journal rules or pyevm.py, and the restore-zero, skipped-entry and four more planted faults were caught on both.

Arc v0.8.6 ran 1,062 sequences with no mismatch and six planted faults caught. The value hook runs before the child checkpoint, reads the blocklist through the journal and writes nothing; accepted and rejected value calls inside reverted and committed frames left balances, the 0x3600 face, the lock and count words and the Transfer log as the journal rules require on the official and the publicnode endpoints.
A re-insert-zero fault in the transient arm of JournalEntry::revert was caught on World Chain, Zora, Celo, X Layer and Arc.
Not attempted in this cycle; the time went to the three new journal lifts.
